scene: a kitchen counter on new years morning, eleven mismatched glasses stood in a loose crowd with one chipped rim turned to the front, a roasting tin with two cold potatoes left in the fat, a foil-topped bowl, a wine cork on its side, flat grey daylight from a window over the sink

a canal towpath in thick january fog, the water perfectly still and the same colour as the air, an iron mooring ring and a length of rusted chain in the near foreground, the far bank dissolving completely, one bare branch hanging in from the top edge

a deep bowl of dark brown lentil soup on a bare wooden table, a spoon standing upright in it, a torn crust of dark bread on the wood, an enamel pan with the lid tilted behind, one bare bulb overhead, a black window at the back

two mixing bowls on a hall carpet under a radiator, one holding an inch of clear water and the other nearly black, a small radiator key and a folded tea towel gone grey beside them, skirting board and a shut front door behind, hard hall light from above

a bedside table crowded with a fortnight of illness, two mugs with tea rings dried inside, a half-pressed blister pack, a glass of flat water, a thermometer on a folded paper, a lamp switched on in the afternoon, curtain edge and grey light behind

the pressure gauge of a wall-mounted boiler in close view, white dial with a red needle sitting just past one, a green band and a red band on the face, a pencil tick drawn on the white casing beside it, a copper filler pipe below, torch light from one side

an open sketchbook page laid flat, twelve painted grey swatches in a hand-ruled grid, each one mixed slightly differently and labelled underneath in small handwriting, a paint-crusted palette and a jar of grey water at the top edge, evening lamplight

a hospital car park at eight on a january morning, still nearly night, wet tarmac holding long orange smears of the sodium lamps, four cars scattered across empty painted bays, a barrier arm down, a low black hill of trees against a barely lighter sky

nine mounted exam boards pinned in a row along a school corridor wall, each a black-backed sheet of drawings and photographs and torn tissue, one of them hung noticeably straighter than the rest, a fire door and a strip light at the end of the corridor
